name: header-name
js: for (const id of ['Site name', 'Subtitle']) { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((e) => e.textContent.startsWith(id)); const g = l.closest('.form-group'); g.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; g.style.outlineOffset = '6px'; g.style.borderRadius = '6px'; }

name: header-links
js: const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('legend')].find((e) => e.textContent === 'Menu link 2').closest('fieldset'); f.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; f.style.outlineOffset = '2px';

name: header-add
js: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((e) => e.textContent.includes('Add menu link')); b.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; b.style.outlineOffset = '4px';

name: header-bad-address
js: const i = [...document.querySelectorAll('input')].find((e) => e.value === '/#contact'); i.value = 'www.ownhousing.example'; i.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true'); i.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', 'error_outlineUse a page on this site, a web address, an e-mail address or a phone number.');

name: header-buttons
js: for (const t of ['Sign-in button', 'Visit button in the phone menu']) { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('legend')].find((e) => e.textContent === t).closest('fieldset'); f.style.outline = '5px solid #B4502A'; f.style.outlineOffset = '2px'; }
